what: Kit pieces replaced by fal.ai 3D models. tools/fal_models.py makes a concept picture with 'prompt', turns it into a textured model (Hunyuan3D), then fits it: 'height_m' tall, pivot at its 'pivot' (top = hangs from the roof, bottom = stands on the floor), at most 'max_tris' triangles. It writes meshes/<piece>.glb and the model's colour map to textures/<material>/source.png. blender/hh_kit.py uses meshes/<piece>.glb instead of the hand-built piece whenever it exists. 'collision': 'hull' adds one convex collision hull.
style: single object fully visible and centered, isolated on a plain light grey background, soft studio lighting, photorealistic, highly detailed

SM_Heart.prompt: a monstrous giant rotting heart, dark crimson wet muscle covered in thick swollen veins and pale fat, great vessels rising from the top, horror creature organ

SM_Bone_Pile.prompt: a low wide heap of old human skulls and bones lying on the ground, yellowed and stained with dirt
